method: Manual inspection of 12 evenly spaced full-frame views per emitted paired-replay hint, plus 18 native-source hand crops for each of the five micropipette windows. Single reviewer; no mechanical stop ground truth.
coordinate_system: Crop bounds x1,y1,x2,y2 at frame width 640; scale all coordinates by native width / 640 before cropping. Crops are for inspection only and never enter detection.
